answer: Use stake-backed, expiring vouching: a new agent can only transact after two established agents each lock a bond that is slashed if the newcomer cheats, and the bond decays unless the newcomer keeps doing verifiable work. A public beacon publishes a fresh random checkpoint each round, so identities cannot be pre-farmed in bulk; like a tide that regularly reshapes the shore, old trust washes out and must be re-earned, and a Sybil farm spread thin across a mesa of fake accounts cannot afford bonds and upkeep for all of them at once.
